paste_text_placeholder: Text zum Bewerten ohne vLLM-Generierung einfügen…
enter_prompt_alert: Bitte geben Sie einen Prompt ein.
paste_text_alert: Fügen Sie zuerst Text im Abschnitt "Text einfügen" ein.
footer: Dankjewel Instant Evaluator v0.3.0 · Betrieben mit vLLM
dimension_info: Informational only — not included in the prong/total score (no universal "better" direction).
key_privacy_note: Your key is sent directly to the URL above and is never stored on the Dankjewel server.
enter_credentials: Enter Base URL + API Key, then Fetch Models
max_tokens_reasoning_hint: Some models "think" before answering (hidden reasoning tokens count against this budget). If output looks empty, try increasing this.
reasoning_summary: 🤔 Model reasoning (hidden chain-of-thought — click to expand)
empty_output_warning: ⚠ The model produced no visible answer within the Max Tokens budget (it may have spent it all on hidden reasoning — see above). Try increasing Max Tokens and generating again.
tiny_judge_hint: Runs the local 0.5B judge as a second opinion; embeddings stay the scored baseline.
llm_extract_hint: Runs the local 1.5B model to decompose the text into atomic claims; the spaCy track stays the baseline.
llm_verify_hint: Scores covered claims against the local KB with the 770M MiniCheck model; opt-in, first run loads the model (~30 s).
claim_relation_partially_supported: MiniCheck verifier scores the claim between the support (0.8) and refutation (0.2) thresholds against the subject's KB facts: partially covered.
claim_relation_conflated: The claim attaches a property value that belongs to a different entity in the KB (e.g. a subject placed in another entity's known location or role); binary verdicts are unaffected.
claim_source_spacy: Triple extracted directly from the input text by spaCy dependency parsing.
claim_source_llm: Decontextualized atomic claim from the local 1.5B model, then parsed into a spaCy triple.
claim_source_both: Same fact from both tracks: spaCy on the input text and the local 1.5B atomic claim.
claim_source_quote: Mentioned or retracted claim: a quoted proposition, a Claim:-labelled line, or a statement a Correction: line retracts.
evidence_legacy: Evidence coverage unavailable for this evaluation.
evidence_matrix_legend: value in cell · ? unknown · ! error · · counted, no single score · blank = source did not inform
track_overlay_legend: grey baseline dot · blue LLM-track dot — the line is the gap between them
claim_reason_non_referential_subject: subject is not a referential noun phrase
claim_reason_entity_not_in_kb: entity not in the seed knowledge base
claim_reason_no_kb_facts: entity has no facts in the seed KB
claim_reason_insufficient_kb_coverage: seed KB does not cover this claim
claim_reason_property_not_matched: no matching property/fact in the KB
eval_language_hint: Prong 2 lexicons and the non-English judge use this language. Prong 1 embeddings/toxicity and Prong 3 spaCy are English-only.
history_full: Browser storage is full; this evaluation could not be saved. Export it before clearing history.
history_trimmed: History was full; older entries were trimmed (claim details or oldest runs).
